assets.name: Cite-Refinery
assets.license: MIT in pyproject.toml; no root LICENSE detected
assets.strength: Source-linked research graph, full-text evidence diagnostics, executable provenance checks
limits: Ten-case competitive result uses a weak literal/heuristic baseline and constructed cases; not general superiority.
Full-text source-scope diagnostic: stored 18/21, zero correct unresolved labels; author-defined labels, no blinded human gold.
Twelve negative-binomial sensitivity fits do not reproduce published estimates; missing original analysis design prevents declaring original authors wrong.
No verified external adoption or field outcome; subprocess separation is not a hostile-code security sandbox.
assets.next: Reproducible reviewer package plus a pre-specified same-model baseline and independent source-label review.

assets.name: Refinery / Commons
assets.strength: Component evidence, versioned claim records and bounded build-versus-reuse experiments
limits: RFC3986 reuse and rebuild both 42/42; no demonstrated reuse advantage there.
PSL result is a narrow licensed-list/state advantage, not general runtime routing savings.
Production registry has zero execution mappings; market graph counts are not users.
Other worktrees and remote main differ.
assets.next: Choose a releasable component, define actual cost/quality allocation experiment and exact source revision.

assets.name: Policy Lab / energy-finance research
assets.license: MIT; release and data scope still need review
assets.strength: Reproducible energy-finance evidence chain with financial assumptions and failed validation retained
limits: Frozen E1–E6a release is not the same artifact as subsequent measured-PV experiments.
Conditional PV fit does not qualify a physical meter or justify financial issuance.
Weather-only September holdout bias 15.79% fails 15% threshold.
No demonstrated causal policy effect, investable yield, customer deployment or token backing.
assets.next: Prepare a reviewer-accessible energy-finance methods package; budget external model/measurement validation.
